purpose: Zero-shot judge: does the candidate's answer address the exam task? Content/topical relevance only - grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation and fluency are explicitly excluded, so no other assessment dimension leaks into the label.

labels.good: the answer clearly addresses the question / task and stays on topic
labels.average: on the general topic but incomplete, drifts, or only loosely addresses the task
labels.bad: does not address the question, is off-topic, or is non-responsive

decoding: greedy, constrained to the three label tokens (prefix_allowed_tokens_fn)

few_shot_examples.task_block:
<TASK part=P1>
Q1: Tell me about your hometown.
A1: my home town is quite small it is near the sea and quiet i like it because everyone knows each other and there are nice beaches and cafes
few_shot_examples.label: good

few_shot_examples.task_block:
<TASK part=P3>
Q1: Should all university students do part-time jobs? What are the advantages and disadvantages, and your opinion?
A1: yes part time jobs are good because you get money and experience but also i really like playing football on weekends with my friends and we watch movies
few_shot_examples.label: average

few_shot_examples.task_block:
<TASK part=P4>
Q1: Look at the diagram and explain how pollution causes acid rain.
A1: on the weekend i usually meet my friends we go to the cinema or a restaurant and sometimes we play video games at home it is very fun
few_shot_examples.label: bad
